root@41626f833e6f:/app# cat > /app/fit7.py << 'EOF'
> import numpy as np
> import json
> from scipy.optimize import minimize
>
> def read_data(filename):
>     with open(filename, 'r') as f:
>         lines = f.readlines()
>     data = []
>     for line in lines:
>         line = line.strip()
>         if not line:
>             continue
>         # Find numbers with possible commas
>         numbers = re.findall(r'\d+(?:,\d+)*', line)
>         if len(numbers) != 2:
>             print(f'Warning: line does not have 2 numbers: {line}')
>             continue
>         x = int(numbers[0].replace(',', ''))
>         y = int(numbers[1].replace(',', ''))
>         data.append((x, y))
>     if not data:
>         print('No data')
>         return np.array([], dtype=np.float64).T
>     return np.array(data, dtype=np.float64).T
>
> def main():
>     x, y = read_data('/app/graphene.dat')
>     print('Data shape:', x.shape)
>     print('First few x:', x[:5])
>     print('First few y:', y[:5])
>     # Find indices of the two maxima
>     max_indices = np.where(np.diff(np.append([False], np.abs(np.diff(y)) > np.abs(np.diff(y)[1:]))))
>     peak1_idx = max_indices[0]
>     peak2_idx = max_indices[1]
>     x1 = x[peak1_idx]
>     y1 = y[peak1_idx]
>     x2 = x[peak2_idx]
>     y2 = y[peak2_idx]
>     print('Peak1 (G):', x1, y1)
>     print('Peak2 (2D):', x2, y2)
>     # Combined model: y = amp1 / (1 + (x - x01)^2 / gamma1^2) + offset1 + amp2 / (1 + (x - x02)^2 / gamma2^2) + offset2
>     def model(x, amp1, x01, gamma1, offset1, amp2, x02, gamma2, offset2):
>         return amp1 / (1 + (x - x01)**2 / gamma1**2) + offset1 + amp2 / (1 + (x - x02)**2 / gamma2**2) + offset2
>     # Initial guess: use the approximate positions and reasonable values
>     initial = [y1, x1, 10, y1, y2, x2, 10, y2]
>     # bounds: amp > 0, gamma > 0, offset real
>     def residual(p):
>         amp1, x01, gamma1, offset1, amp2, x02, gamma2, offset2 = p
>         return np.sum((model(x, amp1, x01, gamma1, offset1, amp2, x02, gamma2, offset2) - y)**2)
>     result = minimize(residual, initial)
>     params = result.x
>     print('Params:', params)
>     # params = [amp1, x01, gamma1, offset1, amp2, x02, gamma2, offset2]
>     results = {
>         'G': {
>             'x0': float(params[1]),
>             'gamma': float(params[2]),
>             'amplitude': float(params[0]),
>             'offset': float(params[3])
>         },
>         '2D': {
>             'x0': float(params[5]),
>             'gamma': float(params[6]),
>             'amplitude': float(params[4]),
>             'offset': float(params[7])
>         }
>     }
>     with open('/app/results.json', 'w') as f:
>         json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
>     print('Results written to results.json')
>
> if __name__ == '__main__':
>     main()
> EOF
